notes: Additive admin directory detail RPCs (admin_get_product/partner/customer/project/quote/invoice/appointment) and list_portal_support_ticket_replies.

Partner type is now explicit: submit_partner_application takes p_partner_type as its first argument. INDIVIDUAL (particulier) may not supply a KvK; BUSINESS requires a company name and an 8-digit KvK.
Partner type is never inferred from the presence of a KvK number.
Safe activation: ACTIVE is reachable only through partner_try_activate when partner_activation_checklist.can_activate is true. Staff approval alone never activates a partner.

Activation checklist requires partner type, staff approval, 18+ verification, identity verification, type-bound business verification and company details, acceptance of the current agreement version, and an APPROVED payout profile.
payout_eligible is set only while payout_profile_status = APPROVED; activation never infers payout eligibility.
Partners that were ACTIVE before rc.5 are marked legacy_activation_grandfathered and keep the rc.4 reactivation behaviour.
Partner agreement bodies are placeholders with legal_review_status = REQUIRED. They are not binding legal texts and must not be presented as final.
staff_set_partner_compliance_fixture is staging-only synthetic data behind the fail-closed partner_compliance_fixtures flag.
support_internal_notes_rpc remains fail-closed by default; staging may enable it after the ACL matrix is proven.
The rc.1 verifier verify_partner_admin_contracts was retargeted to the typed 7-argument submit signature.
